analyst_view.overall: Early view: Real Valladolid (12th) under Fran Escribá score freely at the José Zorrilla (5-0 against Albacete, 4-3 against Leganés) but were missing Juanmi Latasa, Guille Bueno, De Rooij and Dani Pérez in November with no return dates given. Tenerife (14th) under Álvaro Cervera are drawing a lot (LDDDD) and are dealing with the death of striker Jesús de Miguel after the match against Andorra. The bans listed for Iván Alejo and Dani Martín should be served before mid-December.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Valladolid's home games have been high-scoring and Escribá expects open matches, so I lean slightly higher despite Tenerife's run of draws.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners. Nothing in the news points either way, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.8 cards. Nothing in the news points either way and the referee is not known yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.9 shots. Cervera likes three central midfielders to keep games tight, which fits a moderate total, so I stay with the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.0 shots on target. Whether Latasa is back will matter for Valladolid, so this is one to revisit with team news.
